info.title: dev-site API
info.description: API specification for the dev-site service

get.description: Paginated list of analyzed commits with rollup summary metrics for timeline display. Does not include per-package / export / test-case inventories — fetch those via GET /commits/{hash}.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor (commit hash of the last item from the previous page). Omit for the first page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` on the next request. Null when there are no more pages.

get.summary: Get the full analysis snapshot for a commit
get.description: Returns commit metadata plus per-package metrics, exports, and test cases for a single analyzed commit.

404.description: No analysis snapshot found for this commit hash.

get.description: Compare the analysis snapshots of two commits. `hash` is the baseline ("before"); `other_hash` is the comparison ("after"). Returns added/removed (and changed, for package metrics) inventories.

200.description: Delta between the two commit snapshots.

404.description: One or both commit hashes have no analysis snapshot.

get.summary: Package-scoped symbols for one analyzed commit
get.description: Returns metrics, exports, and test cases for a single package at a commit. Prefer this over full commit detail for the checkout Spec panel — assembly only touches that package's source blobs. For db packages, also includes db_inventory (drizzle tables + query dirs). For spec packages, also includes spec_inventory (OpenAPI schemas + REST resources). For http and sdk packages, spec_inventory is joined from a spec package this package depends on, while exports/tests remain this package's own source modules. For spa packages, spec_inventory is joined through SDK request imports so Spec can show loader routes on a component bundle. layout_issues are live working-tree layout/LoC findings for the package directory (cheap; package-local). Full dead-code workdir scans stay on saf-dev-site issues --workdir — not on this Spec package load.

layout_issues.description: Working-tree package-layout and oversized-file findings (package-local; cheap). Dead-code workdir scans are CLI-only.

public_export_file_paths.description: Repo-relative files from live package.json `exports` (SPA main.ts, test-app.ts). Spec Issues skips these for dead-code so the panel matches `saf-dev-site issues --workdir`.

post.description: Walk git history since the last recorded commit (plus feature-branch tips) and store static-analysis snapshots. Manual trigger — no automatic poller in v1. Request body is an empty object so clients can POST JSON without special-casing.

schema.description: Scan options. Empty object is fine for a full scan; `limit` caps how many new mainline commits are analyzed in this run (feature-branch tips are skipped when limit is set).

limit.description: Max new mainline commits to analyze this run (default 1). Feature-branch tips are skipped when limit is set. Ignored when `commit_hash` is set.

commit_hash.description: Analyze exactly this commit (if not already stored). Used by Current checkout "Scan this commit".

200.description: Scan completed with no per-commit failures; returns which commits were ingested.

scanned.description: Commit hashes newly analyzed and stored.

failed.description: Always empty on 200; non-empty failures use 500.

500.description: Git plumbing failed, or one or more commits failed analysis (`SCAN_FAILED`).

get.description: Resolve git HEAD and report whether that commit has been analyzed, plus package metrics when it has. Also reports local branch compare candidates and the fork-point (merge-base) of HEAD vs `compare_ref` (default `main`). Used by the Current checkout UI.

parameters.name: compare_ref
parameters.description: Local branch name to take the merge-base against. Defaults to the server `main` ref.

product_root.description: Analysis path prefix within the repo (e.g. `products`). Empty string means the whole repository. Package `directory` values are relative to this prefix; prepend it for repo-absolute paths.

branch.description: Short branch name for HEAD, or null when detached.

compare_candidates.description: Local branch names that can be used as `compare_ref` (current branch omitted; configured main ref always included when it exists).

github_repo.description: GitHub `owner/name` for source and commit links. Omitted when the server has no `DEV_SITE_GITHUB_REPO` configured.

400.description: compare_ref is not a valid git object.

get.description: List blob paths at a commit (git ls-tree), optionally filtered by path prefix and/or file extension(s). Prefix matches the exact path, descendants (`docs` matches `docs/guide.md`), and files sharing the stem (`src/Foo` matches `src/Foo.ts`, `src/Foo.vue`, `src/Foo.test.ts` — not `src/FooAsync.vue`). Used for browsing docs and source without checking out.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Commit hash (or other tree-ish) to list.

parameters.name: prefix
parameters.description: Optional path prefix (repo-relative). Matches exact path, descendants (`docs` matches `docs` and `docs/guide.md`), and stem siblings (`src/Foo` matches `src/Foo.ts` and `src/Foo.test.ts`).

parameters.name: ext
parameters.description: Optional file extension filter (e.g. `.md`). May be repeated (`ext=.md&ext=.txt`) or comma-separated (`ext=.md,.txt`).

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: When true, include UTF-8 `content` for each matching file. Requires `prefix` so the whole tree is not dumped.

path.description: Path relative to the repo root.

blob_hash.description: Git blob object hash. Empty string for working-tree-only files at HEAD that are not in the commit tree.

get.summary: Read a file at a commit
get.description: Read the UTF-8 contents of one blob at a commit by repo-relative path. Returns 404 when the path is missing at that ref.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Commit hash (or other tree-ish) to read from.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path relative to the repo root.

commit-ref.description: A branch or tag pointer observed at scan time for a commit.

name.description: Ref name without the `refs/heads/` or `refs/tags/` prefix.

type.description: Whether this ref is a branch or a tag.

is_main_ancestor.description: True when this commit is an ancestor of the configured main branch (including main itself). Used to distinguish mainline history from feature-branch tips.

issue-counts-by-kind.description: Per-kind issue counts for a commit or package (all kinds count as debt).

commit-summary.description: List-friendly commit row — same metadata as Commit, without the nested inventory payloads. Used by GET /commits.

summary_metrics.description: Rollup counts across all packages at this commit, for timeline health indicators without fetching CommitDetail.

debt_count.description: Sum of all issue kinds (dead-code + oversized-file + package-layout).

has_issue_stats.description: True when package_issue_stats were computed for this commit (including a zero-debt sentinel). False for commits scanned before issue stats.

commit.description: Analyzed commit metadata — one row per scanned commit. Does not include per-package / export / test-case payloads (see CommitDetail for those).

parent_hashes.description: Parent commit hashes (empty for the root commit).

refs.description: Branch/tag pointers that currently resolve to this commit.

analyzer_version.description: Version string of the analyzer that produced this snapshot.

computed_at.description: When this snapshot was written to the database.

package-metrics.description: Per-package file/LOC inventory at a single commit.

directory.description: Package directory relative to the analyzed product root.

kind.description: Package layer kind. From package.json saf.kind when set, otherwise inferred from a unique identifier dependency such as @saflib/drizzle (db), @saflib/express (http), @saflib/openapi (spec), @saflib/sdk (sdk), or @saflib/vue (spa).

debt_count.description: Sum of all issue kinds (dead-code + oversized-file + package-layout).

export-entry.description: One exported symbol extracted from a source file at a commit.

package_name.description: npm package that owns this file.

file_path.description: Path relative to the repo root.

signature.description: Syntactic display signature from the AST (no type-checker). Null for re-exports without a local declaration.

docstring.description: First prose line of the leading JSDoc on the export declaration. Null when absent or for bare re-exports (`export { a }`).
docstring.example: Walk commits newest-first without checking out.

used_by.description: Non-test product files that import this export (named import match, or whole-module import when names are `*` / default / empty).

file_path.description: Path within the importing package (no package-root prefix).

test-case.description: One `describe`/`it`/`test` case extracted from a test file. `full_name` uses the `" > "` separator from `@saflib/parser` (e.g. `"outer > inner > does the thing"`). Optional `subject*` fields soft-link to an exported symbol by convention (suite title matching an adjacent or same-package export).

package_name.description: npm package that owns this file.

file_path.description: Path relative to the repo root.

full_name.example: log > returns commits newest-first (git log order)

subject_name.description: Linked export name when a suite title matches by convention.

subject_signature.description: Signature of the linked export at this commit (null if unknown).

subject_docstring.description: First JSDoc prose line of the linked export, when present.

subject_file_path.description: Repo-relative path of the file that declares the linked export.

subject_confidence.description: How the link was made (`adjacent` file vs elsewhere in package).

commit-detail.description: Full static-analysis snapshot for one commit — metadata plus per-package metrics, exports, and test cases.

code.description: A short, machine-readable error code, for when HTTP status codes are not sufficient.

message.description: A human-readable description of the error.
message.example: The requested resource could not be found.

db-schema-table.description: A drizzle table identity for schema diffs.

db-schema-column.description: A drizzle column identity for schema diffs.

commit-diff.description: Delta between two analyzed commits. Exports and test cases are identity-based (add/remove only — a rename shows up as remove + add). Package metrics include a `changed` list when the same package_name exists on both sides with different counts.

db_schemas.description: Structural drizzle table/column deltas across both commits.

db-inventory.description: Drizzle table inventory for one db package (schemas + query dirs).

entity.description: Query directory name or kebab form of table name (e.g. package-metrics).

docstring.description: First prose line of leading JSDoc on the table const.
First prose line of leading JSDoc on the column.

used_by_packages.description: Distinct packages (non-test) that import any query under this entity.

queries.description: Leaf query modules under queries/<entity>/ (excluding index and tests).

used_by.description: Non-test product files that import this leaf query module.

file_path.description: Path within the importing package (no package-root prefix).
Path within the importing package (no package-root prefix).

spec-inventory.description: OpenAPI inventory for one spec package — business objects (schemas/) and/or REST resources (routes/), linked by normalized name stems. Operations include links to HTTP handlers and SDK requests from packages that depend on this spec. Also attached to http package detail for the HTTP Spec pane.

package_directory.description: Repo-relative directory of the spec package this inventory was built from (used for route YAML source links when shown from an http pane).

entities.description: Flat alphabetical list of object / both / routes entities.

key.description: Stable entity key (e.g. both:Matter, routes:admin, object:Error).

label.description: Display name — schema component name when present, else resource folder.

presence.description: object = schema only; routes = REST resource only; both = schema + matching resource.

yaml_path.description: Package-relative path to the schema YAML.

referenced_by_operations.description: operation_ids whose request/2xx response $ref this schema.

used_by_packages.description: Distinct packages importing this entity's schema and/or the SDK request modules for its operations.

operations.description: REST operations under the linked resource (empty for object-only).

yaml_path.description: Package-relative route YAML under the spec package.

handler.description: Sibling HTTP handler file when present.

request.description: Sibling SDK request module when present.

fake.description: Sibling SDK fake/MSW module (`*.fake.ts`) when present beside the request.

handler_tests.description: describe/it/test specifications extracted from colocated HTTP handler test files (full_name uses " > " nesting).

full_name.example: createMatter > creates a matter for the org

request_schemas.description: Business objects in the request body (one layer deep into object/array bags of schema refs).

response_schemas.description: Business objects in 2xx responses (one layer deep into object/array bags of schema refs).

used_by.description: Non-test product files importing the sibling SDK request module for this route stem.

file_path.description: Path within the importing package (no package-root prefix).

enqueues.description: operation_ids this op may enqueue (product job trigger map). Present only when the HTTP app was configured with a map.

enqueued_by.description: operation_ids or `cron:…` keys that may enqueue this op. Present only when the HTTP app was configured with a map.

checkout-compare.description: Fork-point (merge-base of HEAD and a chosen branch) for Checkout compare mode.

merge_base_analyzed.description: True when that fork-point commit has an analysis snapshot.

merge_base_authored_at.description: Author date of the fork-point commit.

renames.description: File rename pairs from the fork point to HEAD (`git diff --find-renames`). Used by Checkout compare to show moved modules instead of remove+add.

client.description: The frontend client that triggered the event. For web, it should be "web-{spa-name}".

view.description: The page that triggered the event. For vue, it should be the route name provided by vue router.

component.description: The component that triggered the event. For vue, it should be the component name.
